The set of variants represented is unchanged.

evidence.quote: GT: Genotype, encoded as allele values separated by either of / or |, e.g., 0/1 or 1|0. The allele values are 0 for the reference allele (what is in the REF field) and 1 for the first allele listed in ALT, 2 for the second allele listed in ALT, etc.
Number=A means one value per allele (including REF). Number=R means one value for REF plus one value per ALT allele. Number=G means one value per possible genotype.
